summary.title: Executive Summary — The Week in Numbers

blocks.label: The week in one line
blocks.text: Nifty 50 +0.44% · FPI equity -₹34,934 Cr · USD/INR 96.82 · Brent +2.42% · breadth mixed.
FPIs: a net equity outflow of ₹34,934 Cr across 5 NSDL reporting days (0 of 5 positive); debt +₹2,773 Cr.
USD/INR 96.82 (+0.62%, rupee weaker); Brent $104.72 (+2.42%); India 10-year 7.29% (+8 bp); US 10-year 5.24% (-3 bp).
Nifty 50 +0.44% to 22,520.45, Midcap 150 -0.19%, Smallcap 250 -0.08% in the week to 9 Oct.

Of 1,563 coded names in the scan, 570 rose and 984 fell on the week (median -1.13%). Breadth regime: **mixed**, with 30.1% above the 50-DMA and 44.9% above the 200-DMA (-17.2 and -12.6 points over four weeks).
Stage 2 by calculation (all 7 template checks): 303 names, 47 entered and 73 left since 1 Oct. The provider's Stage 2 list (701 names) was not updated this week (the list on file is dated 13 Sep).

SwingEdge sub-sector trackers: 10 of 32 trackers rose. Led by Sugar & Ethanol (+6.62%), Optical Fibre & Telecom Gear (+3.97%), Jewellery & Gold Retail (+3.68%); lagged by Wind (-7.47%), CNC Machines (-5.71%), API & Bulk Drugs (-5.06%). The equal-weight market line: -0.64%.

blocks.label: How this report is built
blocks.text: Built automatically by `tools/auto_weekly.py` from data the evening pull already has: the screener.in scan, NSE's index file, NSDL's FPI Monitor, RBI's current rates, Yahoo closes, and SwingEdge's own breadth, Stage 2 and tracker files. No model writes any of it: each sentence is a template filled with the week's numbers. Not collected: DII daily flows and derivatives positioning (no keyless source). Facts only; nothing here rates a stock.
